# observability.EvalExperimentSummary

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

An eval experiment of an agent on a dataset, with scores per scorer and the gate verdict.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `observability.EvalExperimentSummary` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.eval.read` |

| `status` | yes | `none` | Experiment status. |  |
| `verdict` | yes | `none` | Gate verdict: every scorer at or above its baseline. |  |
